preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) >= 1 and len(S) <= 10**6 and all(c in '01' for c in S) for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string S is a binary string of length between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(min_operations(S)) for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]]]
postconditions.description: For each test case string S, the output is the minimum number of operations (flip or compress) required to make all characters in S equal (all 0s or all 1s).
